text:
carmen: Quick ping — opened PR #8423 to extend audit log schema so KMS events include key_id and hsm_fingerprint. Need security + SRE approvals before merge. Link: <https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/8423|PR 8423>. Can someone take a look today? Thx.

ben: :eyes: looking now. quick q — does this change the persisted shape or is it additive? Will any consumers break?

carmen: Additive only, old fields preserved. Consumers should be forward-compatible (unknown fields ignored). Added migration notes to the PR description and unit tests for compatibility.

maria: @carmen thanks for the ping. I can review — please attach the compliance checklist entry (PCI/PaaS) and a short note on how key rotation affects the audit entries. We also need to confirm KMS key ids are encoded consistently.

carmen: Added compliance checklist snippet and a KMS rotation impact note. Also included a short schema diff in the PR: 

```json
- {"event_type":"kms","payload":{...}}
+ {"event_type":"kms","payload":{"key_id":"<string - base64url>","hsm_fingerprint":"<string>" , ...}}
```

dave: FYI CI integration flagged the log-parser test — parser currently asserts exact keys. I'll open a follow-up PR to relax parsing to ignore unknown keys so this doesn't break consumers.

carmen: That would unblock things, thanks. Also tagging @tess for release window — we want to canary this change before wide merge. Preferred canary window: 01:00-03:00 UTC.

tess: 01:00-03:00 UTC works for a canary. Need a DRI to watch logs and rollback if needed. @ben can you be DRI for the canary window?

ben: I can be DRI. I will monitor alerts and watch the parser metrics. Also requesting approvals from @maria and @sre-oncall before merge.

maria: Reviewing now — left one comment about key_id encoding. Please use base64url (no padding) for the key_id to avoid +/= chars in logs.

carmen: Good catch — switched to base64url (updated tests and PR description). Pushed.

dev-bot: CI update — <https://ci.redwood.com/job/8423/27|build #27> — all checks passed ✅

ben: :thumbsup: infra side LGTM.

maria: LGTM from security, approving now. Added myself as approver on the PR.

sre-oncall: Approved. Please merge to canary branch and hold full rollout until canary completes.

carmen: Merging into canary now. Will follow up with canary status in this thread. Thanks everyone :tada:
